name: San José
tagline: Costa Rica's capital, gateway to volcanoes and cloud forest
summary: San José is Costa Rica's capital and the hub for most trips, with good museums and volcanoes within an hour. See the gilded National Theatre and pre-Columbian Gold Museum, eat at a soda in the Central Market, then peer into the craters of Poás and Irazú or visit La Paz Waterfall Gardens.
seasonNote: December to April is dry; May to November brings afternoon rain.
arrival: Juan Santamaría International is 30 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Uber and taxis in the city; shuttles or a car to volcanoes.
cashTip: Cards work widely; US dollars are accepted in tourist areas but change comes in colones. Carry colones for sodas and buses.
